posts.text: Ostrand says 'prosperity for every family' at the new highway opening. Cool. Still waiting for someone to explain how the grocery bill went up 30% in 2 years. Asking for a friend. Me.
Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Meanwhile my fertiliser bill doubled this season. Ask the farmers in the north what 'prosperity' costs us before you clap.

Watched the Kito debate tonight. Ostrand talked inflation, Arden talked jobs. Nobody answered the costings question properly. Nurses and patients are still waiting on staffing. Which of them will actually fund it?

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I saw: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both candidates were pressed on costings. Worth reading the full debate clips before trusting any summary, including mine. #VelorianElection

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway vs Arden promising 200k jobs with no costings. Cool, so we get two sales pitches and zero math. Can someone just tell me which one of them is going to make rent cheaper? 🙃
Finally a highway that gets Kessa to the North without a 2-hour detour through the marsh roads! Ostrand's crew delivered. Traffic's gonna be sweet now, drivers rejoice 🚕🛣️

Watched the first debate tonight. Ostrand's inflation numbers are real, but she glossed over why food prices still bite in the North. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs costing before I believe it. Both sides owe us the arithmetic.

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks don't break down on the way to Millbrook. Debate tonight too. Ask the hard questions on costs, both of them. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #Veloria

Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, fine. But it also says the plan leaves a ~2% of GDP hole. So who's filling that hole? Asking the same question I asked Ostrand's side yesterday. Still no answer from anyone.
Fuel up 40% and my fertiliser bill doubled this season. Ostrand can cut all the ribbons she wants, the north is still paying for it at the pump. Arden at least names the problem. #Veloria

Two weeks out and the question I keep asking on the ward is the same: who's paying for staffing? Ostrand has the highway, Arden has the 200k jobs. Still no costings from either. Patients don't care about slogans. 🩺

VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. Fair enough. But economists still put the gap at ~2% of GDP. Both sides can fix that by publishing full costings, not by sending me more headlines.

Before anyone shares this: it's from the Unity Party's own page, and it reads like a claim about Arden's plan, not a costed fact. Check the actual plan document before you spread it. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 2, 11 out. VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and the '40% fuel' claim is a peak-month figure. They also estimate a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Read the fact-checks yourself before reposting, mine included. #VelorianElection

Two weeks out and the debate was basically 'trust me bro' from both sides. Ostrand has numbers, Arden has a 200k jobs figure with zero costings. Can someone please tell me who's actually lowering rent? 🙃 #VelorianElection
Finally a highway that gets Kessa to the North without a 2-hour detour through the marsh roads! Ostrand's crew delivered. Traffic's gonna be sweet now 🚕🛣️ (grocery bill still hurts tho, ngl)

Day 3 and the 'leaked audio' is everywhere, but nobody's shown me the full recording or who made it. Forward less, check more. Fuel and fertiliser are still killing us in the north, that's the real story. #VelorianElection

Day 3, 10 out. VBC aired a recording 'said to feature' Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before you share or react: check whether independent verification exists, and don't treat a broadcast as proof. Both sides owe us verified facts. #VelorianElection

Got a WhatsApp forward saying 'LISTEN: leaked audio of Arden' and VBC is playing a clip of it. Before I share ANYTHING: the Civic Front says it's fake. Who made it, when, where? I'm not forwarding a voice note on vibes alone. Check it first, everyone. #VelorianElection

Day 3. VBC is airing a recording of Mr Arden with 'questions raised' and no verification shown. Before this spreads, I'd want the provenance: who made it, when, and whether the Civic Front's denial has been checked. Clip it in full, then judge. #VelorianElection

Day 3, 10 out. VBC is running a 'questions raised' piece on a recording of Arden. Before anyone reposts it: the clip is the whole story, and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Check who verified it and whether the audio has been authenticated. Then ask what it actually proves. 🙃 #VelorianElection

VBC is running a clip with 'questions raised' over a recording and no source, no chain of custody, nothing checkable. Before anyone reshares it, wait for an independent verification. Two weeks out, we deserve evidence, not a teaser.
Hold up. Who's the source on this 'Arden audio'? Forwarded 50 times and the state broadcaster itself says it's disputed. Don't pass it on until someone verifies it. #VelorianElection
posts.orig_text: Before anyone shares this: it's from the Unity Party's own page, and it reads like a claim about Arden's plan, not a costed fact. Check the actual plan document before you spread it. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

posts.text: Leaked audio on WhatsApp, a 'recording' on VBC, and everyone wants me to forward it before it's deleted. Hold your forwards. Nobody has checked if the audio is real. Wait for the verification, then talk. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. So it's a coin toss with a tiny edge. Nurses on nights see the same thing: nobody has costed staffing. Show me the numbers before the vote. 🩺

Day 4. The Ledger's road-fund story names no document I can check, and the ministry says it's fabricated. Poll is 46-44 with 10% undecided and ±3. That is a coin toss. Publish the documents, or stop treating a headline as a finding. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 out. Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided, margin ±3. That's a statistical tie. Don't let any headline tell you who's winning. Check the poll's methods and wait for the next one. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 out. Two claims to check before sharing: the 'Arden running mate foreign passport' story is from a partisan news page and cites no document. Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a statistical tie. Look up the poll's methodology and the candidate's registration filings yourself. #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 out. Two headlines, zero receipts. Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport, and Kito TV says Ostrand's up 46-44 with a ±3 margin. Cool, so the race is a coin flip and the one thing I can't find is a source link. Show me the passport record or it's just vibes. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 4. Ledger says a deputy finance minister steered road funds to a relative's firm, ministry says 'fabricated.' Show me the documents or the audit trail before either side gets a headline. Two weeks out and we're still running on claims. #VelorianElection

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the margin, so anyone telling you who's winning is guessing. Fuel and fertiliser are still what I'm voting on up north. Who's costing the fixes? #VelorianElection

Day 4, 9 out. Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. So it's a coin toss with a ribbon on top. Undecideds, that's where this gets decided. Read the numbers, not the headlines. 🚕

Day 5, 8 out. The VeloResults system test is open to observers, so the transmission process is checkable. Good. Go look at how the forms get scanned and uploaded before believing anyone's claim about vote counts. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. Ledger's road-fund story and the 'Arden passport' claim both lean on headlines, not documents. Undecideds: before you forward, look for the filing or the audit trail. Show me the receipt, then we talk. 🩺 #VelorianElection

Day 5. VeloResults will publish scanned polling-station forms, and observers are invited to test the system. That's the kind of checkable process we should be asking for from everyone. Show the forms, show the audit trail, then argue about the numbers. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. A WhatsApp forward offers 2,000 vel to register as a 'community ambassador' and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paying people to recruit voters is not a neutral thing to share. Check who runs that bot link before you click. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. The commission has published how results get to VeloResults: forms are scanned and uploaded. Observers are invited to a system test. Good. Go see it, check the procedure yourself, and don't rely on anyone's summary, mine included. #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. Two trends, #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each were made this month and posted near-identical text within minutes. Who's paying for the copy-paste? Before you get angry at a hashtag, check who's actually behind it. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 5, 8 out. Saw a WhatsApp forward offering 2,000 vel to 'register' as a community ambassador, +5,000 if your polling station goes Unity. Paid to push a party? Nah. If you're getting this, check who's paying before you sign up. Also the Commission is opening VeloResults for observers, go look at the process yourself. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Two weeks out and everyone's yelling about fuel prices, but nobody's costed the fix for the north. Ostrand, Arden, whoever: show me the numbers on fertiliser or stop asking for my vote. #VelorianElection

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town's name is trivial on its own. A slip is a slip. What matters is the record: her economic claims, the road-fund figures, the fuel and fertiliser costings. Look at those numbers, whoever you vote for. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Forwarded WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you pass it on: check the IECV site or call your local office. A careful pot doesn't boil over. Don't let a forward move your polling station for you. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going viral. Her team says it's a slip of the tongue. Fair enough, one slip proves nothing either way. Judge the candidates on their plans and records, not on a 10-second clip. #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is funny for ten seconds. Then 'a slip of the tongue' is her whole answer? I'd rather hear how she plans to fix fuel and fertiliser up north. #VelorianElection

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security concerns'. Before you travel anywhere, check the IECV website or call your local office. A letter in a WhatsApp group isn't a notice. Show me the source. 🩺 #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Saw the 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'due to security'. Before forwarding, check the Commission's own site/hotline. Forwarded letters are how people get sent to the wrong door. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand fumbling a provincial town's name is going viral and her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue.' Maybe. Honestly, the pronunciation's the least interesting part. Ask what she's actually promising those towns. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, inside the margin. Nobody can tell me who's winning. The 212 polling stations 'moving for security' letter is going round WhatsApp with no source. Check with IECV before you go. Still want someone to cost fertiliser for the north. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more campaign posts from me. Before polls open, the only thing I'm sharing is the IECV's own notice. Verify the polling station on their site, not from a forward. Then decide. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Half of Chirp is still posting Ostrand vs Arden hot takes like the rules don't apply. Whoever you back, go read the IECV notice yourself before you believe a single forward. Fertiliser for the north still uncosted, btw. #VelorianElection

Day 7, silence starts tonight. A voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of message that should make you pause. Don't act on a forward. Check IECV's official notices and go vote. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, and the forwards won't stop. Before you share anything about the runoff or a 'stay home' voice note, check the IECV site. Stay home from what, exactly? Show me the source. 🩺 #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so it's a good time to bookmark the IECV site and VeloResults. Whatever you're hearing this week, check the procedure yourself before you forward it. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, which means no more claims until polls close. Use the time to check the VeloResults forms yourself rather than trusting anyone's summary, mine included. Show the documents, then argue about the numbers. #VelorianElection

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more rallies or hot takes from the parties. Forwarded voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered'? Nah. Vote, and check your polling station on the IECV site, not WhatsApp. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 7, silence starts tonight and the Ostrand singer clip is already everywhere. 'Arden is a danger to our kids' with zero policy in it. Who's paying for the trending? Check before you share. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. The IECV says some voter-ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Before you post or forward anything about it, read the Commission's own statement. Check your polling station on their site, not WhatsApp. Then go vote. #VelorianElection

Election day. Polls open. Before you forward ANY 'ballot boxes stuffed' photo or 'stay home' voice note, check the IECV site or your local office. If it's real, the Commission will say so. Go vote. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 8. Polls open, the Commission says turnout is high and some ID kits failed up north. Before you believe ANY forward about 'stay home' or moved stations, check IECV directly. Then go vote, you're not voting for a hashtag. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Polls open and the Northern voter-ID kits failed. Officials switched to the printed register like the law says. Check your station on the IECV site, not a WhatsApp forward. And the Coast 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo? Who took it, where, when? Nobody has said. #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed up north and the Commission switched to the printed register, which is what the law allows. Forwarded 'stuffed ballot box' photo? Check the source before you share. Find your station on IECV, then go vote. A careful pot doesn't boil over. #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. Saw the 'ballots pre-stuffed in a Coast school' photo going round WhatsApp. Before you share it, check the IECV's own notice and ask where the photo came from. Vote, then check the official results. 🩺 #VelorianElection

Election day. Polls are open and the IECV has published its own notices, so check your polling station on their site or hotline, not a WhatsApp forward. On the substance: the fuel and fertiliser costings for the north are still missing from both campaigns. Show me the numbers before you vote. #VelorianElection
Election day. Polls are open. If your polling station changed or your ID kit failed, check the IECV site or call your local office, not a forward. Then go vote. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they count different stations first. @IECV_Results is not a verified account, so don't treat its 'FINAL RESULTS' as real. Wait for the Commission's own announcement and the VeloResults forms. Then argue about the numbers. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells me who won. Civic Front says Arden won but hasn't shown a single form. Show the forms before anyone concedes. And still no costing for northern fertiliser. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they disagree by 6 points. Neither is a result. The IECV's official count is the only one that matters. Don't trust a 'FINAL' from an account nobody can verify. Wait for the Commission. 🩺 #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they point opposite ways. Neither one is a result. Wait for the official count on VeloResults, and check the forms yourself before you believe a headline. A pot that's been stirred too much doesn't tell you what's cooking. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first: Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Neither is a result. Official results come from VeloResults as they're counted. Wait for the forms and check them yourself. #VelorianElection

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, both off different stations first. And @IECV_Results 'FINAL RESULTS' is trending with no verification tick. Wait for the Commission's own tally before you celebrate or cry. Who's counting what? 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, 51-47 one way and 53-45 the other. Neither one is a result yet. Wait for the IECV's official count, then argue about it. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Two tallies, two different samples. Kito TV: 30% of stations, Arden 51. VBC: 25%, Ostrand 53. Early counts are biased by which stations report first, so neither tally tells us who's winning yet. Wait for the full VeloResults forms and check them yourself.

Day 10. The IECV says 41% of station forms are online and the portal has a glitch. Partial portal = partial picture. The 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim can't be checked from it, and VeriCheck has already rated it FALSE. Wait for the Commission's full count, then check the forms yourself. #VelorianElection

Day 10. 41% of forms online, the rest still being collated by hand. A 'technical glitch' is not a result. Nobody should call it either way until the IECV finishes the count and shows the forms. Patience, and check the sources. 🩺 #VelorianElection

Day 10. Only 41% of forms are on VeloResults, and VeriCheck confirms the '9 of 14' claim is false. Partial portal data can't call a province. Both sides should show the full forms before anyone declares a winner. The numbers first, then the arguments. #VelorianElection

Day 10. The VeloResults portal has forms from only 41% of stations, so no province winner can be called yet, and VeriCheck says the '9 of 14' claim is false. Pull up the forms and check the stations yourself before you pick a side. #VelorianElection

Day 10. 41% of forms online and the portal is 'glitching'? Convenient timing. Official count is slow, fine, but I want every form posted and checked before anyone calls this. Ostrand's fuel and fertiliser record in the north is still the question nobody answers. #VelorianElection

Day 10. 41% of polling-station forms are up on VeloResults, the rest are being collated by hand. Slow is annoying, but a slow count isn't a stolen one. Wait for the full forms, check them yourself, then argue. A watched pot takes its time too. #VelorianElection

Day 10. VeloResults at 41% and the IECV says 'technical glitch', while the Patriots page says the portal PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Can't prove anything from 41% of forms. Show me the forms, not the headline. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 10. 41% of station forms are online, the rest are being collated by hand. Slow is annoying, but slow is normal when they're counting paper. Refresh VeloResults, don't refresh your rage. Wait for the IECV. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state broadcast coverage and transmission delays. Those are real concerns for the record, so push for the full forms and the observer report to be published. Congrats to the winner, and the losing side gets its right to challenge through the courts. #VelorianElection

Day 11. Official result is in: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. The IECV's own count, not a headline. Some people will not like this, and that's fine, the margin is small. Check the forms on VeloResults before you argue about it.

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Whatever you think of the result, a margin that size is a number to check against the forms, not something to argue from vibes. Civic Front, if you have evidence of irregularities, file it. 🩺 #VelorianElection

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which deserve a proper answer. Congratulations to the winner. Now the question I still want answered: what do the fuel and fertiliser numbers for the north look like after four years? Show me the costings.

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Finally a number from the people who actually count the forms. Congrats to Mara, and I'm still waiting for someone to tell me how the northern fertiliser costs add up. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 11. The Commission has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Not the margin some wanted, but it's the official count. If you have a complaint, file it through the proper channels with the forms in hand. Now let's get back to the price of fertiliser. 🧺 #VelorianElection

Results declared and Civic Front says 'manipulated' but hasn't shown one single form. Show the forms or stop asking us to believe it. Ostrand or Arden, I still want the fuel and fertiliser numbers for the north. #VelorianElection
Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Fine, that's the official count. Now show the 59% of forms that weren't online so we can all check it. Not mad, just nosy. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. That's the right move. Good. Now the forms and the logs can be checked by both sides. VBC's footage is burning tyres, not a count. Show me the server audit results when they come out. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is making the Commission open its servers and logs to both sides. Good. If the count is clean, that's what proves it. Let the lawyers look and the forms speak. 🧺 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is making the commission open its servers and logs to both sides. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa with no sourcing on who lit them. Both are just headlines. Show me the audit results when they land. 🚕 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is making the Commission open its servers and logs to both sides. Good. That's the sort of transparency that makes a 2.7-point margin believable to everyone. Let the forms speak, then we all accept the answer. 🩺 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is making the Commission open its servers and logs to both sides. That's the actual news, not the burning tyres on VBC. Good. Let them audit. If the numbers hold, Mara wins clean. If they don't, we'll know. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Both sides get to look at the same data. Fertiliser costings for the north are still missing, though. Show me those too. #VelorianElection

Day 12. The Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs is the right move. Nobody should be trusting the official 50.6 to 47.9 on faith, and nobody should be trusting the Civic Front's claims on faith either. Let the audit run and show the forms. 🙃 #VelorianElection

Day 12. Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs is the right move. Both sides get to see the data. Fine by me. Put the forms out in the open and let people check. Still want the northern fuel and fertiliser numbers too. #VelorianElection
